items.title: 30.3 Chemical environment aur chemical shift (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of topic 30.3 with Quick Check 30.1 answered (PDF 203-206). Answers need review.

blocks.text: Chemical shift NMR spectroscopy ki aik important parameter (ahem cheez) hai. Yeh batati hai ke koi signal aik reference (hawala) compound ke muqable mein kahan aata hai. Tetramethylsilane, Si(CH₃)₄, jise aam taur par TMS kehte hain, standard reference hai aur is ke signal ko 0.0 ppm value di jati hai. Sample ke hydrogen nuclei (protons) ke baqi tamam signals isi TMS zero point se nape jate hain.

blocks.title: Chemical shift
blocks.text: ¹H NMR spectrum mein TMS peak ke muqable kisi peak ki jagah ko chemical shift (δ) kehte hain; yeh parts per million (ppm) unit mein napi jati hai.
Chemical shift proton ka electronic environment batati hai. Different environments wale protons ki δ values alag alag hoti hain, aur aik hi environment wale protons ki δ value aik hoti hai.

blocks.title: Did You Know? (kya aap jante hain?)
blocks.text: TMS NMR ke liye standard compound ke taur par khaas taur par suitable (munasib) hai, kyunke is ke tamam 12 protons ka chemical environment aik hai aur yeh aik sharp (patli, nokeeli) peak deta hai. Silicon ki electronegativity kam hai, is liye TMS ke protons spectrum ke bilkul daen (right) kinare par aate hain aur zyada tar organic protons ke signals ke saath overlap nahi karte (un par nahi chadhte). TMS chemically inert (react na karne wala) aur volatile (jaldi urne wala) hai, is liye use ke baad aasani se nikal jata hai.

blocks.alt: Tetramethylsilane ka structure: beech mein silicon atom, chaar CH3 groups se jura, oopar, neeche, baen (H3C) aur daen. Label: Tetramethylsilane (TMS).
blocks.caption: Tetramethylsilane (TMS) (kitab ke Did You Know box ke structure ke mutabiq hamari drawing).

blocks.text: Misal ke taur par methanol ke ¹H NMR spectrum (Figure 30.2) mein methyl (-CH₃) hydrogens ki peak 3.35 ppm par hai; TMS ke 0.0 ppm ke muqable yahi in protons ki chemical shift hai. Isi tarah methanol ke O-H hydrogen ki chemical shift 4.80 ppm hai.

blocks.alt: Delta scale 6 se 0 par 1H NMR spectrum. 4.80 par chhoti peak (blue label), 3.35 par lambi peak (pink label), aur 0 par TMS ki peak. Oopar baen methanol ka displayed formula: C-H ke teen hydrogens pink aur O-H ka hydrogen blue.
blocks.caption: Figure 30.2: Methanol ka 1H NMR spectrum (kitab ki Figure 30.2 ke mutabiq hamari drawing).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Teen CH₃ protons 3.35 ppm par bari peak dete hain aur akela O-H proton 4.80 ppm par chhoti peak. Peak ka size protons ka number dikhata hai (3 aur 1). TMS ki peak 0 par reference hai.

Molecule mein protons (¹H) electrons se ghire hote hain, aur yeh electron density NMR spectrum ki shakal par asar dalti hai. Molecule ke alag alag hisson mein protons ke qareeb alag atoms aur bonds hote hain, is liye un ke "environments" different hote hain.

blocks.title: Chemically equivalent protons
blocks.text: Molecule ke jo protons (¹H) bilkul aik jaise chemical environment mein hon, woh chemically equivalent (barabar) hain aur us molecule ke ¹H NMR spectrum mein un ki chemical shift aik hi hoti hai.
TMS, methane, ethane, benzene aur propanone (acetone) ke tamam protons chemically equivalent hain. Is liye in mein se har compound apne ¹H NMR spectrum mein sirf aik peak deta hai (Figure 30.3).

blocks.alt: Methane, ethane, benzene aur cyclohexane ke displayed (khule) formulas. Har molecule ka har hydrogen atom Ha likha hai.
blocks.caption: In molecules ke tamam hydrogen atoms ka chemical environment aik hai (30.3 mein chhape structures ke mutabiq hamari drawing).

blocks.alt: PPM scale 3 se 0, aur taqreeban 0.2 par aik sharp peak. Plot ke andar methane ka displayed formula aur sentence (jumla): The protons are equivalent and give one NMR signal (protons barabar hain aur aik NMR signal dete hain).
blocks.caption: Figure 30.3: Methane ka 1H NMR spectrum (kitab ki Figure 30.3 ke mutabiq hamari drawing).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Har molecule ke tamam hydrogens par Ha likha hai, yani sab ka environment aik hai. Is liye methane ke spectrum mein sirf aik peak hai.
Doosri taraf, jis molecule mein chemically different protons ke alag alag sets hon, un ki chemical shifts alag alag hoti hain aur spectrum mein aik se zyada peaks aati hain.

blocks.alt: Do boxes. Pehla: propane (kinare ke chhe hydrogens Ha, beech ke do Hb) aur methanol (C-H ke teen Hb, O-H ka Ha); likha hai: Molecules having two different chemical environments for protons. Doosra: 1-chloropropane (chlorine wale end se Hc, Hb, Ha) aur ethanol (CH3 ke Hc, CH2 ke Hb, O-H ka Ha); likha hai: Molecules having three different chemical environments for protons.
blocks.caption: Protons ke do aur teen different chemical environments wale molecules (30.3 mein chhape boxes ke mutabiq hamari drawing).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Har letter (a, b, c) aik environment hai. Propane aur methanol mein do letters (a, b) hain, is liye do peaks; 1-chloropropane aur ethanol mein teen (a, b, c), is liye teen peaks.

Misal: ethanol (C₂H₅OH) mein -CH₃ group ka proton -CH₂- aur O-H ke protons se different hai. -CH₃ ke teenon protons ka environment aik hai, aur -CH₂- ke dono protons ka environment aik hai. Proton (¹H) ki chemical shift us ke gird ki electron density se asar leti hai. Jo protons zyada electron density mein ghire hon (alkyl groups), un ki chemical shift kam hoti hai. Jo protons kam electron density mein hon (F, O, N, Cl jaise electronegative atoms ke qareeb), woh zyada chemical shift par aate hain. Maslan methanol mein -CH₃ protons ke gird electron density zyada hai, is liye woh 3.35 ppm par aate hain, jab ke O-H proton ke saath electronegative oxygen hai, is liye woh 4.80 ppm par aata hai (Figure 30.2).

¹H NMR spectrum mein chemical shift (δ) ki range 0 – 12 ppm hai. Protons ke different environments ki chemical shifts Table 30.1 mein di gayi hain. Yeh data table kisi na-maloom (unknown) compound ke ¹H NMR spectrum mein protons ka environment pehchanne aur predict karne mein madad deta hai.

blocks.caption: Table 30.1 Kuch aam qism ke protons ki chemical shifts
rows: Electronegative atom ke saath alkyl (halogenoalkanes, alcohols)

blocks.prompt: a) TMS ke 12 protons sirf aik peak kyun dete hain?
blocks.explanation: Sab protons aik hi jaise environment mein hain (har aik Si se jure CH₃ group mein), yani chemically equivalent hain, is liye sab ki chemical shift aik hai.

blocks.prompt: b) In molecules mein protons ke kitne chemical environments hain, aur har environment ki chemical shift kitni hogi? i) 1,1,2,2-dichloroethane ii) propane iii) propan-2-ol iv) butan-2-one
blocks.explanation: i) Aik environment; chlorine ke saath wala proton, Table 30.1 ke mutabiq 3.0 – 4.5 ppm ke qareeb ya us se zyada (neeche 'Kitab ki ghalti' dekhein). ii) Propane: do (CH₃ aur CH₂), dono alkyl, 0.5 – 1.5 ppm. iii) Propan-2-ol, (CH₃)₂CHOH: teen; CH₃ 0.5 – 1.5, O ke saath CH 3.0 – 4.5, OH 0.5 – 6.0 ppm. iv) Butan-2-one, CH₃COCH₂CH₃: teen; C=O ke saath CH₃ aur CH₂ dono 2.0 – 2.6 ppm, aur ethyl ka CH₃ 0.5 – 1.5 ppm.

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Kitab ne ‘1,1,2,2-dichloroethane’ chhapa hai. Yeh naam mumkin nahi: chaar locants (1,1,2,2) ke liye chaar chlorine chahiye, yani 1,1,2,2-tetrachloroethane, Cl₂CH–CHCl₂. Agar 1,2-dichloroethane, ClCH₂–CH₂Cl, matlab tha to bhi jawab aik hi hai: tamam protons barabar (equivalent) hain, sirf aik environment.

blocks.prompt: e) δ 7.5 ppm par signal shayad (likely) kis proton environment ka hai?
blocks.explanation: Aromatic ring se jure hydrogen ka (Ar–H, 6.5 – 9.0 ppm).

items: Chemical shift (δ) peak ki jagah hai, TMS (0.0 ppm) se napi jati hai, unit ppm.
Chemically equivalent protons aik signal dete hain; environments gin kar peaks gin sakte hain.
Electronegative atom ke qareeb proton ki δ zyada, alkyl protons ki kam; ¹H range 0 – 12 ppm (Table 30.1).
